verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say you can download the codebase directly from Project settings → Git, or sync it to a GitHub/GitLab repo you own. The GitHub integration explicitly supports working locally and deploying outside Lovable. Missing for 10: detailed guidance on running the Cloud backend (database/auth/functions) outside Lovable, and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting an exported app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export the full source code and run or host the app outside the platform

citations.quote: you can download your code directly from Lovable: use the Download codebase section in Project settings → Git
you can export and sync your project to GitHub: back up your code, review changes in pull requests, work locally in your IDE, test features on branches, and deploy outside Lovable
Git sync connects a Lovable project to a repository you own on GitHub or GitLab, and keeps the two in sync automatically
Code: Your app's source code, which you can browse, edit, and download.
